# uConsole hardware matrix

Maintainers have this board, so functions can be verified on hardware.

*Profile* is the profile that provides the function: `free`, `full` (needs non-free artifacts) or `blocked`. See [Free vs non-free](uConsole-Free-vs-NonFree).

| Function | Status | Profile | Features | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| audio | implemented-unverified | free | uconsole-core |  |
| backlight | implemented-unverified | free | uconsole-core |  |
| battery | implemented-unverified | free | uconsole-core |  |
| bluetooth | implemented-unverified | free | uconsole-core |  |
| display | implemented-unverified | free | uconsole-core |  |
| gps | implemented-unverified | free | uconsole-expansion-aio-v1 |  |
| lora | implemented-unverified | free | uconsole-expansion-aio-v1 |  |
| nvme | implemented-unverified | free | uconsole-expansion-nvme |  |
| rtc | implemented-unverified | free | uconsole-expansion-aio-v1 |  |
| rtl-sdr | implemented-unverified | free | uconsole-expansion-aio-v1 |  |
| wifi | implemented-unverified | free | uconsole-core |  |
